info.name: AI Job Search Agent — Local MVP workflow
info.description: Runs the single-user HTTP workflow against a local backend. Keep REMOTEOK_ENABLED and LEVER_ENABLED false to avoid live source requests. If search returns no results, the collection uses its explicit Postman Demo JobOffer fixture to exercise shortlist endpoints. The deterministic fake connector workflow is exercised by backend integration tests, not by this Postman fixture.

item.name: 01 — Health
item.description: Confirms the local FastAPI application is responding.

item.name: 02 — Replace profile
item.description: Creates or replaces the single local UserProfile.

exec: pm.test('profile response has canonical fields', function () { pm.expect(profile.skills).to.include('Python'); pm.expect(profile.jobTitles).to.include('Platform Engineer'); });

item.name: 04 — Patch profile
item.description: Updates selected fields while retaining the rest of the saved profile.

exec: pm.test('PATCH preserves other profile fields', function () { pm.expect(profile.jobTitles).to.include('Platform Engineer'); pm.expect(profile.skills).to.include('Docker'); });

item.name: 05 — Replace preferences
item.description: Creates or replaces SearchPreferences using the current domain fields.

exec: pm.test('preferences response has expected fields', function () { pm.expect(preferences.jobTitles).to.include('Platform Engineer'); pm.expect(preferences.salary.currency).to.eql('USD'); });

item.name: 07 — Patch preferences
item.description: Patches one nested salary field; minimum and currency must be preserved.

exec: pm.test('nested salary PATCH preserves existing fields', function () { pm.expect(preferences.salary.minimum).to.eql(1000); pm.expect(preferences.salary.maximum).to.eql(5000); pm.expect(preferences.salary.currency).to.eql('USD'); });

item.name: 08 — Search (local API; fixture fallback when empty)
item.description: Uses the existing explicit profile/preferences request contract. With all connectors disabled the API should return an empty result; a canonical Postman Demo fixture is then selected only to exercise shortlist HTTP operations. Automated tests cover search with an injected fixture connector.

exec: pm.test('search response has stable top-level contract', function () { ['results', 'matches', 'excluded', 'ranking', 'meta'].forEach(function (key) { pm.expect(body).to.have.property(key); }); });

if (!offer) { offer = { identity: { id: 'postman-demo-001', sourceId: 'postman-demo-001', slug: 'postman-demo-job', offerUrl: 'https://example.invalid/jobs/postman-demo-001' }, source: { name: 'Postman Demo', url: 'https://example.invalid/', retrievedAt: '2026-09-26T00:00:00Z' }, position: { title: 'Platform Engineer', sourceSummary: 'Local Postman demonstration fixture' } }; }

pm.test('selected offer has canonical JobOffer identity/source/position', function () { pm.expect(offer.identity).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(offer.source.name).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(offer.position.title).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(offer).not.to.have.property('matching'); pm.expect(offer).not.to.have.property('recommendation'); });

item.name: 09 — Save search offer to shortlist
item.description: Saves the canonical search result, or the documented local Postman fixture fallback.

exec: pm.test('entry contains a canonical snapshot without match results', function () { pm.expect(entry.status).to.eql('SAVED'); pm.expect(entry.offer.identity).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(entry.offer).not.to.have.property('matching'); pm.expect(entry.offer).not.to.have.property('recommendation'); });
pm.test('saved entry appears in list', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(function (entry) { return entry.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('shortlistId'); })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('entry ID matches the created resource', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('shortlistId')); });
